steps.title: Wet your hands with clean running water
steps.instruction: Wet your hands with clean running water.

steps.title: Apply soap and rub your hands together
steps.instruction: Apply soap and rub your hands together, including between your fingers.
steps.additional_guidance: Pay attention to the spaces between your fingers.

steps.title: Rinse your hands thoroughly with water
steps.instruction: Rinse your hands thoroughly with water.
steps.additional_guidance: Make sure all the soap is washed away.

steps.title: Dry your hands using a clean towel
steps.instruction: Dry your hands using a clean towel.
